full_prompt_en: A square painted caricature shows a smiling man from the chest upward against a warm, largely empty beige ground. His narrow shoulders sit near the lower edge, while an unusually long neck carries a large head into the upper half of the frame. The background has a faint uneven paper or paint texture and a lighter, loosely shaped patch immediately behind the head; no other setting competes with the face. Thick, dark, curly hair flares outward and upward in irregular clumps, with a few stray loops breaking the silhouette along the top and sides. His heavy black eyebrows sweep up and toward the center, guiding attention to small eyes that look slightly upward. An oversized rounded nose projects over a curved smile, and the ears extend broadly on both sides of the face. The jaw narrows into a long, square-ended chin, making the head feel elastic yet structurally believable. Warm ochre, peach, and deep brown strokes model the nose, cheeks, brow, ears, and neck; fine curved marks trace the folds around the eyes and smile. Beneath the face, a white collared shirt and slim brown tie appear between the lapels of a muted brown jacket. The jacket ends in soft, unfinished brush marks at the bottom rather than a rigid rectangular crop. Fine dark outlines and directional hatching sharpen the hair, eyes, and facial creases, while blended paint smooths the broader areas of skin. The subject is centered but subtly turned, allowing the protruding nose, uneven brows, and broad ears to read as a lively three-dimensional exaggeration. A soft light from the upper left warms the forehead and one side of the nose, leaving gentle deeper tones under the hair, jaw, and neck. The overall composition draws attention to the expressive face through enlarged proportions, controlled warm contrast, and the quiet surrounding space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘制的夸张人物画，在暖米色、大片留白的背景前，呈现一名胸部以上入画的微笑男子。他窄窄的肩膀靠近下边缘，一段格外修长的脖颈将大头托进画面的上半部。背景有轻微不均匀的纸面或颜料肌理，头后紧贴一块边缘松散的浅色区域；没有其他环境与面孔争夺注意力。厚密而深色的卷发以不规则发束向外、向上蓬开，几缕散发在顶部和两侧打断剪影。浓黑的眉毛向上并向中央弯起，把视线引向略微上望的小眼睛。硕大圆鼻突出于弯曲的笑容上方，两只耳朵从面部两侧宽宽地伸出。下颌收窄为长而端部方正的下巴，使头部既像弹性变形，又保有可信的结构。暖赭、桃色与深棕色笔触塑造鼻子、面颊、眉骨、耳朵和颈部；细小弧线描出眼周和笑纹。面孔下方，白衬衫领和细棕领带出现在低饱和棕色西装的翻领之间。西装在画面下方以柔软、未完全封闭的笔痕收尾，而不是被生硬的矩形边界截断。纤细的深色轮廓与顺势排线强调头发、眼睛和面部皱褶，较大块的皮肤则由融合的颜料处理得平滑。人物居中而略有转身，突出的鼻子、不对称的眉毛和宽大的耳朵因此读作有活力的三维夸张。柔光从左上方照暖前额和鼻子一侧，在头发、下颌及颈部留下温和的深色调。整体构图借放大的比例、受控的暖色反差与安静的周围空间，将注意力集中在富有表现力的面孔上。
style_prompt_en: The painted caricature style stretches selected proportions while preserving a convincing sense of volume. Bold outer contours and finer directional hatching define expressive features; broad, blended color transitions shape the larger planes between them. Warm ochre and peach highlights rise from a base of umber and brown, while the surrounding field stays pale and lightly textured. Small asymmetries in brows, curves, and edges keep the design animated rather than mechanically mirrored. The strongest contrast gathers around compact focal details, then dissolves into softer paint and unfinished peripheral strokes. Gentle directional light reveals protrusions and recesses without hard theatrical shadows. Generous negative space isolates the main form, and the whole treatment combines humorous distortion with careful, tactile modeling.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘制的夸张画风拉伸选定的比例，同时保有可信的体积感。鲜明的外轮廓与更细的定向排线界定富于表情的特征，宽阔而融合的色调过渡则塑造其间的大块平面。暖赭与桃色亮部从赭褐、棕色底调中浮现，周围色域保持浅淡并带轻微肌理。眉线、曲线与边缘的小幅不对称，使设计显得生动，而不是机械镜像。最强反差聚集在紧凑的焦点细部，向外逐渐化为更柔软的颜料和未完全收束的边缘笔触。温和的定向光显出凸起与凹陷，却没有生硬的戏剧性阴影。充足留白隔离主要形体，整体处理将幽默变形与细致、可感的塑形结合起来。
theme_en: A smiling man with tousled hair and exaggerated features in a brown suit
theme_zh: 一位乱发、五官夸张的微笑男子，身穿棕色西装
name: Caricature
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
